item.title: Bulletin updated at 23:15 HKT 16/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring hot weather and showers to the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. A trough of low pressure will affect southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. With the gradual strengthening of an anticyclone aloft during the weekend and early next week, the weather will be mainly fine and persistently hot over the coast of Guangdong. Another trough of low pressure is expected to bring showers to southern China midweek next week.
